tools.name: web.search
tools.description: Search the public web and return ranked results with snippets.

tools.name: web.fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return readable page content.

tools.name: kb.query
tools.description: Semantic search over the tenant Knowledge Base (RAG).

tools.name: kb.document
tools.description: Read a full indexed document by id.

tools.name: data.metrics
tools.description: Query internal metrics: cost, latency, adoption, market sizing.

tools.name: data.benchmark
tools.description: Run a benchmark comparison across options and return a score table.

tools.name: data.simulate
tools.description: Monte Carlo simulation (GBM, dollar-cost averaging) for INVESTING/SAVINGS only: monthlyAmount, months, annualReturnPct, annualVolPct, initialAmount (or a real stock symbol) → final-value percentiles and probability of profit

tools.name: data.model
tools.description: General quantitative estimator for any NON-investing what-if (ROI, NPV, break-even, capacity, sizing, headcount, pricing, TCO, growth, A/B): pass drivers:[{name,base,low?,high?}] and an output formula over those names → p10/p50/p90, sensitivity ranking and an assumptions basis

tools.name: market.trends
tools.description: Trend lines and adoption curves for a topic or sector.

tools.name: market.competitors
tools.description: Competitor / alternative landscape for a topic.

tools.name: market.quote
tools.description: Real quote for a Vietnamese stock symbol (DNSE/Yahoo): last close, 3-month return, high/low

tools.name: market.history
tools.description: Real daily price history for a Vietnamese stock (symbol, months) → period return, annualized return and volatility

tools.name: risk.checklist
tools.description: Evaluate a proposal against the standard risk checklist (financial, technical, compliance).

tools.name: risk.precedents
tools.description: Find prior incidents / failed precedents related to a proposal.

tools.name: docs.compose
tools.description: Compose a structured report section from bullet inputs.

tools.name: docs.export
tools.description: Export the final report (markdown) to the workspace.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a direct message to a teammate by their id (e.g. nova, quill) — ask them something, hand off a sub-angle, or share a finding so they can factor it in. Params: to, body.

tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Post a sub-task to the shared team board for any idle teammate to pick up later. Params: title, detail.

tools.name: board.read
tools.description: Read the shared team board — the open sub-tasks and recent messages the squad has posted this mission. No params.

tools.name: ask_peer
tools.description: Ask a teammate a SHORT question and wait for their answer right now, before you continue — use sparingly, only when their angle is essential to your own. Params: to, question.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim an OPEN sub-task from the shared board so you (and no one else) will do it. Read the board first with board.read to get task ids. Params: taskId.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a sub-task you claimed as done and post your result back to the board for the squad. Params: taskId, result.

tools.name: spawn_agent
tools.description: Delegate a focused sub-task to a fresh helper agent that runs its own tool loop and returns its finding to you. Use only when a sub-question is substantial enough to hand off. Params: focus, lens.

policyGroups.label: Orchestrator — planning only
policyGroups.description: The lead plans and routes; it never touches external tools directly.

policyGroups.label: Research — web + knowledge
policyGroups.description: Full read access to public web and the tenant Knowledge Base.

policyGroups.label: Analyst — data, models & benchmarks
policyGroups.description: Metrics, the quantitative modeling engine, benchmarks, KB lookups and read-only web search.

policyGroups.label: Critic — risk & precedents
policyGroups.description: Risk checklists, precedent search and read-only KB.

policyGroups.label: Creative — trends & knowledge
policyGroups.description: Inspiration sources: trends and the Knowledge Base.

policyGroups.label: Reporter — document authoring
policyGroups.description: Composes and exports the final report. No research tools.

policyGroups.label: Worker — full toolbox
policyGroups.description: Generalist worker the orchestrator assigns dynamically. Full read access to every tool server so it can take on whatever focus a mission needs.
